items.summaryEn: Formula 1 stakeholders have reached an agreement on the main elements of the next engine rules cycle. The FIA and F1 engine manufacturers have opted against a naturally aspirated option, partly because of noise restrictions at street circuits, with a smaller and simplified electronics package.
detailZh: 未来F1引擎规则的首批细节揭晓
F1下一阶段引擎规则的最初方案已经公布：3.0升V8涡轮增压，搭配更小的电动机，并减重50公斤
F1利益相关方已就下一阶段引擎规则周期的主要要素达成一致。
FIA和F1引擎制造商选择放弃自然吸气方案，部分原因是街道赛道的噪音限制，同时采用更小、更简化的电子系统。
一种超车推进模式也正在考虑之中，并可能在2030年首次亮相。
尽管讨论仍在进行中，但即将定义F1下一个技术周期的引擎已基本成型。国际汽联与制造商之间的会议将继续敲定剩余细节，但已在关键点上达成实质性协议，重点是一种更简单、更轻的动力单元，被认为更接近赛车引擎的传统概念。
F1将转向3.0升V8架构，但最令引擎制造商分歧的问题之一是要不要保留涡轮增压器。
选择自然吸气引擎的可能性也曾被摆上桌面，这种方案能带来一种特别吸引怀念2000年代初F1的车迷的声浪。
费尔南多·阿隆索驾驶雷诺R25领先迈克尔·舒马赫驾驶的法拉利F2005
然而，涡轮增压器元件将保留为动力单元配置的一部分，但这一决定背后的原因超越了纯粹的技术考量。
一台自然吸气的3.0升V8发动机将达到的噪音水平，会给当前一些F1举办地带来重大问题。
这一问题尤其涉及街道赛道：墨尔本、迈阿密、马德里、新加坡、巴库和拉斯维加斯都是实行噪音排放限制的举办地，而比当前一代明显更吵的赛车的到来，可能会造成无法克服的重大困难，甚至可能使一些赛事面临风险。
这导致决定保留较小的涡轮增压器，这是一种折衷方案，仍应能够实现比当前动力单元响亮得多的声音，同时将噪音水平控制在某些F1赛道适用的限制范围内。
更小的电动机和更轻的动力单元
新的V8也不会完全脱离电气化。新规则看起来将包括一个简化的100kW电动机，其输出远低于当前一代动力单元的350kW。
目标是在不与汽车行业失去技术联系的同时，避免复制最新一代动力单元所特有的复杂性。讨论中浮现的方向很明确：电力仍将是F1的一部分，但在整体组合中的作用将不那么主导。
近年来经验教训似乎已被吸取的另一个领域，涉及整个动力单元的重量。新动力单元设定的目标非常雄心勃勃：要制造出一个比当前动力单元至少轻50公斤的完整单元。
正在考虑引入超车按钮和2030年启用
一些方面仍需最终确定。其中之一将是给车手提供额外动力提升以协助超车动作的系统。
似乎无意重新引入直到2025赛季末仍在使用的DRS。目前正在考虑的方案更接近IndyCar采用的超车按钮理念：车手可在特定情况下使用的临时动力提升。
这将是FIA和引擎制造商仍需达成最终协议的一个领域。
新规何时引入F1也仍悬而未决，计划在2030年首次亮相新规则是一个选项，这将把当前技术规则周期的结束提前一年。
达成决定需要各方找到共同点，但当前一代动力单元出现的问题加速了一场超越个别技术细节的更广泛讨论。在大力推动技术复杂性之后，F1似乎热衷于回归更传统的赛车引擎概念。
detailEn: First details of future F1 engine rules revealed
The initial plan for F1’s next engine regulations have been revealed: 3.0-litre V8 turbo, with a smaller electrical motor and 50kg lighter
Formula 1 stakeholders have reached an agreement on the main elements of the next engine rules cycle.
The FIA and F1 engine manufacturers have opted against a naturally aspirated option, partly because of noise restrictions at street circuits, with a smaller and simplified electronics package.
A push-to-pass overtake mode is also under consideration, along with a possible debut in 2030.

While discussions are still ongoing, the engine set to define the next technical cycle in F1 has largely taken shape. Meetings between the FIA and the manufacturers will continue to finalise the remaining details, but a substantial agreement has been reached on the key points with the focus on a simpler and lighter power unit, one that is considered closer to the traditional concept of a racing engine.
F1 is set to move to 3.0-litre V8 architecture, but one of the issues that most divided the engine manufacturers was whether to retain the turbocharger.
The possibility of opting for a naturally aspirated engine was also on the table, a solution that would have delivered a sound particularly appealing to fans nostalgic for F1 in the early 2000s.
Fernando Alonso, Renault R25, leads Michael Schumacher, Ferrari F2005
However, the turbocharger element will remain as part of the power unit configuration, but the reasons behind the decision go beyond purely technical considerations.
A naturally aspirated 3.0-litre V8 would have reached noise levels that would cause a major problem with some of the current F1 venues.

The issue concerns street circuits in particular: Melbourne, Miami, Madrid, Singapore, Baku and Las Vegas are venues where noise-emission restrictions are in place, and the arrival of cars significantly louder than the current generation could create major difficulties that would be impossible to overcome and potentially even put some events at risk.

This has led to the decision to retain a smaller turbocharger, a compromise that should still make it possible to achieve a considerably louder sound than that of the current power units, while keeping noise levels within limits applied at some F1 circuits.
Smaller electrical motor and lighter power units

The new V8 will not be completely detached from electrification either. The new rules look set to include a simplified 100kW electric motor, a considerably lower output than the 350kW current generation of power units.

The aim is to maintain a technological link with the automotive industry without replicating the complexity that has characterised the latest generation of power units. The direction emerging from the discussions is clear: electric power will remain part of F1, but with a less dominant role within the overall package.

Another area where the lessons of recent years appear to have been taken on board concern the weight of the overall power unit. The target set for the new power unit is highly ambitious: to produce a complete unit weighing at least 50kg lighter than the current power units.
Push-to-pass and 2030 introduction being considered
Some aspects still need to be finalised. Among them is the system that will give drivers an additional power boost to assist overtaking manoeuvres.

There appears to be no intention to bring back the DRS used until the end of the 2025 season. The solution currently under consideration is closer to the push-to-pass philosophy adopted in IndyCar: a temporary increase in power that the driver could deploy under specific circumstances.
This will be one of the areas the FIA and the engine manufacturers still need to reach a definitive agreement on.

When the new regulations will be introduced in F1 also remains open, with the plan to debut the new rules in 2030 an option, which would bring forward the end of the current technical rules cycle that began by one year.

Reaching a decision will require all parties to find common ground, but the issues that have emerged with the current generation of power units have accelerated a broader discussion that goes beyond individual technical details. After pushing hard on technological complexity, F1 appears keen to return to a more traditional concept of a racing engine.
keyPointsZh: 初步方案为3.0升V8涡轮增压引擎，配备更小的电机，重量减轻50公斤。
推超车模式（push-to-pass）也在考虑之中，并可能在某站首次亮相。
keyPointsEn: The initial plan is a 3.0-litre V8 turbo with a smaller electrical motor and 50kg lighter.
A push-to-pass mode is also under consideration and could debut at a certain race.

detailZh: 埃斯特班·奥康认为自己是“自由身”，而哈斯尚未决定2027年F1车手阵容。
这位法国人表示，他正在与其他车队讨论明年的选择——即使F1的机会正在减少。
埃斯特班·奥康宣称自己是“自由身”，因为哈斯尚未决定其2027年F1赛季的车手阵容，但他并未排除可能留在车队的可能性。
尽管这位法国人近期的表现有了很大提升，但由于哈斯的性能已从赛季初的积分区状态下滑，这些表现大多未获回报，奥康的席位已受到威胁一段时间。
哈斯一直在利用其旧车测试（TPC）计划来寻找下赛季与奥利·贝尔曼搭档的潜在人选，法拉利青训车手拉斐尔·卡马拉、卫冕F2冠军莱昂纳多·福纳罗利以及现任储备车手平川亮都在考虑之列。
奥康确认他正在为2027年寻找其他选择，而哈斯继续评估其明年的车手组合。近期有传闻称，车队倾向于让卡马拉——现任F3冠军、今年F2积分榜第二——明年出战，尽管车队领队小松绫雄在西班牙大奖赛期间表示，他有“大约五名”车手在竞争。
“是的，目前我绝对是明年的自由身，”奥康表示。
“有些事情正在讨论中，但不在我的控制范围内，有些话题也不在我的控制范围内。所以我会继续努力到年底，看看情况如何。”
当被问及留在哈斯是否是一个选项时，奥康守口如瓶，回应道：“让我们看看”。
奥康补充说，他对近期的表现感到满意，本赛季初他因赛车表现不稳定而受苦。
目前尚不清楚这是空气动力学敏感性问题还是部件质量控制问题；小松表示两者都可能是原因，并且车队仍在调查当前的问题。
“我们知道这是一个持续存在的问题，”他说。“令人欣慰的是我做得不错。显然，我的表现今年不是问题。
“每次我拿到车，我都发挥出了水平。在摩纳哥我是最后一个得分的。在马德里我几乎得分。有很多次当赛车表现不佳时，我都发挥出了水平。这很清楚。
“车队里的每个人都在密切关注，试图解决问题。我们没有回避。但有时显然对这类问题感到相当失望。”
贝尔曼被问及如果奥康离开，他是否觉得自己准备好作为车队领袖挺身而出，这位英国人表示，在作为队友的近两年里，他从队友身上学到了很多。
埃斯特班·奥康，哈斯F1车队，奥利·贝尔曼，哈斯F1车队
他指出，奥康在工程会议中的反馈是他受到启发的地方，同时他自己在赛道上的表现也在提高。
“我在这里，嗯，这是我作为全职车手的第二年，但我也在哈斯做了一年储备车手，之前一年也参加了几场比赛和FP1，甚至在2023年，我做了我的第一次FP1。所以我对车队有很好的经验水平，”贝尔曼说。
“我觉得我在赛道表现方面提高了很多，而且在描述我在车里的感受等方面也是如此。这是我肯定从像埃斯特班这样经验丰富的人身上学到很多的地方。所以在这方面，对我来说是非常好的学习。
“即使我比较12个月前的反馈，我不确定我会有信心只依赖自己的反馈。但我觉得在这方面我已经迈出了很好的一步，这真的只是一个正常的学习过程。”
detailEn: Esteban Ocon considers himself a "free agent" with Haas yet to decide on F1 2027 drivers
The Frenchman says he is talking to other teams about options for next year - even with F1 opportunities dwindling
Esteban Ocon declared himself a "free agent" as Haas is yet to decide its driver line-up for the 2027 Formula 1 season, but did not rule out potentially staying at the team.

Although the Frenchman has been enjoying much improved performances of late, which have gone largely unrewarded as Haas' performance has slipped away from its early-season points-scoring form, Ocon's seat has been under threat for some time.

Haas has been using its testing of previous cars (TPC) programme to identify a potential partner for Ollie Bearman next season, with Ferrari junior Rafael Camara, reigning F2 champion Leonardo Fornaroli, and current reserve Ryo Hirakawa in the frame.

Ocon confirmed that he was looking for other options for 2027, while Haas continues to assess its driver pairing for next year. Recent rumours have surfaced suggesting that the team is leaning towards Camara - currently the reigning F3 champion and second in this year's F2 standings - for next year, although team boss Ayao Komatsu stated during the Spanish GP that he had "maybe five" drivers in contention.
"Yes, at the moment I am definitely a free agent for next year," Ocon stated.
"There are things in discussion that are out of my control and there are certain topics that are out of my control. So I will keep pushing until the end of the year and see how it goes."
Asked if staying at Haas was an option, Ocon remained tight-lipped and responded: "let's see".
Ocon added that he was pleased with his performances of late, having suffered this season with an inconsistent car in the early stages of the season.
It is unclear if this is an aerodynamic sensitivity issue or a parts quality control problem; Komatsu has suggested both could be causes, and that the team is still investigating the issue at hand.
"We know it's been an ongoing issue," he said. "It's reassuring that I'm doing a good job. Obviously, my performance hasn't been an issue this year.

"I've performed every time I had the car. I've been the last one to score in Monaco. I was almost scoring in Madrid. There's been a lot of times where I've performed when the car was underperforming. It's been clear.

"Everybody in the team has been following that very closely, trying to fix the problem. We haven't been hiding from it. But it's been quite disappointing at times, obviously, to have these kind of problems."

Bearman was asked if he felt ready to step up as the team leader should Ocon depart, and the Briton stated that he'd learned a lot from his team-mate across the almost two years spent together as team-mates.
Esteban Ocon, Haas F1 Team, Oliver Bearman, Haas F1 Team
He pointed to Ocon's feedback in the engineering room as something that he'd taken inspiration from, along with his own improving performances on-track.

"I've been here for, well, this is my second year driving as a full-time driver, but also I've been one year as a reserve for Haas, also did a few races and FP1s the year before that, even in 2023, I did my first FP1. So I have a really good level of experience with the team," Bearman said.

"I feel like I've improved a lot in terms of my on-track performance, but also how I describe what I'm feeling in the car and things like that. And that's something I certainly learned a lot from someone who's very experienced like Esteban. So on that side, it's been really good learning for me.

"Even if I compare my feedback to 12 months ago, I'm not sure I would have the confidence to just rely on my own feedback. But I feel like I've made a good step in that regard, and it's just a normal learning process, really."

detailZh: James Hinchcliffe称汉密尔顿与法拉利2026年F1争冠希望已"破灭"
James Hinchcliffe认为刘易斯·汉密尔顿与法拉利的2026年F1总冠军希望已经结束
前IndyCar系列赛车手、F1 TV评论员James Hinchcliffe在西班牙大奖赛代价高昂的退赛后宣布，刘易斯·汉密尔顿与法拉利的2026年F1总冠军希望已经"结束"。
这位七届世界冠军在全新的马德里赛道赛道遭遇刹车问题。因此，他现在在积分榜上落后领跑者安东内利 101分，落后第二名乔治·拉塞尔20分。
法拉利目前在车队积分榜上排名第二，但已落后梅赛德斯145分。
在F1 Nation播客节目中，Hinchcliffe被问及是否认为汉密尔顿和马拉内罗车队已经退出冠军争夺。
"是的，当然，"他说。"他们会有闪光时刻，他们会赢下一些比赛。我很想看到他们在年底前再赢下一两场大奖赛，但你说的是落后超过三场大奖赛的积分，对刘易斯来说甚至是四场。"
随着冠军渐行渐远，Hinchcliffe建议法拉利将重心转向2027赛季会更有益。
"结束了。已经结束了。现在是时候为'27年努力了，"他补充道。"他们不必担心维持冠军争夺的压力。他们可以在每个比赛周末，也许在调校上、在缺乏测试的情况下带到赛道的研发上，稍微更具实验性，对吧？"
"如果这是15年前、20年前，你有了这套新规则，车手们难以驾驭，车队们试图追赶那支搞明白的车队，你会在每场大奖赛之间每周都进行测试并努力改进。"
"你现在没有这种自由。模拟器能做的有限。你唯一接触赛车的时间就是在比赛周末，而那时比赛至关重要，很难把这段时间用来做实验和真正承担额外风险，无论是驾驶、调校更改还是其他什么。"
"当你退出冠军争夺时，就像法拉利现在这样，你就可以让自己几乎把这些比赛周末视为测试周末。"
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton and Ferrari 2026 F1 title hopes are "over", says James Hinchcliffe
James Hinchcliffe believes Lewis Hamilton and Ferrari’s 2026 F1 championship hopes are over

Former IndyCar Series driver and F1 TV pundit James Hinchcliffe has declared Lewis Hamilton and Ferrari's 2026 Formula 1 championship hopes "over" following a costly retirement at the Spanish Grand Prix.

The seven-time champion suffered a brake issue at the brand-new Madring circuit. As a result, he now sits 101 points behind championship leader Kimi Antonelli in the standings and 20 points behind George Russell in second.
Ferrari currently sits second in the constructors' championship but is now 145 points behind Mercedes.
Speaking on the F1 Nation podcast, Hinchcliffe was asked if he thought Hamilton and the Maranello outfit were out of the championship fight.

"Yes, certainly," he said. "They'll have flashes, they'll have races. I'd love to see them win another grand prix or two before the end of the year, but you're talking about over three grands prix worth of points behind, well four for Lewis."
With the championship slipping away, Hinchcliffe suggested that it would be beneficial for Ferrari to shift its focus to its 2027 campaign.

"It's done. It's over. Now it's about working on '27," he added. "They don't have to worry about the pressure of keeping a championship fight alive. They can go to each race weekend, maybe be a little bit more experimental with set-ups, with developments they're bringing to the track in the absence of testing, right?

"If this was 15 years ago, 20 years ago, and you had this new set of regulations and drivers were struggling to drive them and teams were trying to catch the one team that figured it out, you'd be pounding around testing every week in between every grand prix and working on it.

"You don't have that freedom now. Simulators can only do so much. And your only time in the race car is when it matters on race weekends, which is a tough thing to use as a time to be experimental and to really take extra risks, whether it's with driving, with set-up changes, whatever.
"When you are out of the championship fight, as is Ferrari, then you can resign yourself to almost looking at these race weekends as test weekends."

items.titleZh: 加斯利谴责因科拉平托事件遭受的"令人不安"辱骂
items.summaryZh: 皮埃尔·加斯利公开谴责他与家人（包括女友）在社交媒体上收到的"令人不安"的辱骂和威胁，此事与他在西班牙大奖赛阻挡队友科拉平托有关。
items.originalTitle: 加斯利谴责因科拉平托事件遭受的"令人不安"辱骂
items.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly has publicly condemned "disturbing" abuse and threats he and his family members, including his girlfriend, received on social media following the incident in which he held up his Alpine team-mate Franco Colapinto at the Spanish Grand Prix.
detailZh: 在西班牙大奖赛中阻挡阿尔派车队F1队友弗兰科·科拉平托之后，皮埃尔·加斯利抨击了他及其家人（包括女友）在社交媒体上遭受的“令人不安”的辱骂和威胁。
事情源于马德里赛道比赛尾声的一圈，当时加斯利在进圈过程中挡住了科拉平托——后者正准备以第七名完赛，但身后有迈凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里紧追——导致其减速后才进站。虽然这没有让科拉平托损失位置，但确实让他被压到被皮亚斯特里追近，并导致他多次通过无线电抱怨。
最终获得第12名的加斯利以及他身边的人随后在多个社交媒体平台上遭到攻击，他将这些攻击描述为不合适的。
“就我个人而言，我觉得这对我们的运动来说有点令人不安，”当The 比赛问及他如何应对社交媒体上的反击时，加斯利说道。
"我是顶级运动员，所以我知道自己会暴露在公众视野中，一直都是这样，但这些威胁和攻击的程度，我觉得完全不可接受，尤其是当波及到家人、[我的]女朋友等等时。我认为不应该出现这种情况。
"过去并不是这样的，作为一项运动，我们只是需要想办法让它变得更健康一些，因为你会暴露在外，你知道自己会遭到攻击。
"你可以被人喜欢，也可以被人讨厌，这完全没问题，但有些界限是不应该跨越的，仅仅因为你躲在屏幕和键盘后面，而这些界限被跨越的次数太多了。"
Colapinto 表示他了解这些辱骂行为，并支持 Gasly 关于必须制止这种情况发生的立场。
"我想他收到了很多人的信息," 科拉平托说。"我没有看到,因为我不怎么上社交媒体,但收到那些东西从来都不好受,尤其是当这种事发生在我所效力的车队身上时。"
"我们是队友,我们相处得非常好。我们都在为同一个结果而努力,有同样的目标和方向——那就是让阿尔派变得更好。我们始终作为一个团队在工作,看到这种情况并不好受。"
"所以,希望他们能停止这种行为。其他车手也遭遇过同样的事——去年角田裕毅也经历过,当时情况也挺糟糕的,我谈论过这件事。"
"关于干事们,Zandvoort之后我也去见了他们。在他们对我做出处罚后,我也收到了一些辱骂。在F1中,车迷的这种行为很常见,如今在任何体育项目中都是如此,这已经很普遍了。"
“很遗憾，这种情况本不应该如此常见。可以肯定的是，我们应该更加注意从每个人键盘上敲出来的那些东西、那些话。”
“作为一个团队，支持我们的方式就是推动团队向前，并一起保持坚强。”
“希望这种事不要再持续发生了。但在这项运动中，车迷的问题确实很棘手。不仅仅是我的车迷。我有一些非常狂热的车迷。他们希望我表现出色。希望他们能享受我取得的好成绩。”
科拉平托还回应了一种说法，即由于超车难度大，他和加斯利在马德里之间最终发生的事情并不是什么大问题，他指出了当时皮亚斯特里对他构成的威胁。
"嗯，我差点被 Oscar 追上！只差了0.2秒，" Colapinto 说。
"我们在车队里进行了沟通，大家一起处理好了这件事。和 Pierre、Flavio [Briatore]、Steve [Nielsen]，车队里的每个人都非常努力地去弄清楚发生了什么，以及下次如何改进。
"我想我对结果很满意。最重要的是从可以改进的地方吸取教训。下次不要再发生同样的事情——然后我们继续前进。"
这一情况源于比赛早期的虚拟安全车（VSC），这让使用中性胎起步的 Colapinto 得以进站，而 Gasly 则继续留在场上使用硬胎。
尽管加斯利在比赛后段通过无线电愤怒地抱怨了这一策略，但从结果来看这一策略是合理的，因为它让加斯利有机会在虚拟安全车、安全车或红旗出现的情况下以最高第六名完赛，而且他从来没有机会进站后还能保持积分区位置。
科拉平托在第二段比赛中被加布里埃尔·博托莱托挡住了相当长一段时间，但当这位奥迪车手在第47圈进站后，他被放了出去。随后他开始迅速逼近加斯利，皮亚斯特里也在追赶他。到第55圈开始时，他已经落后加斯利1.5秒。
当加斯利被告知将在该圈结束时进站时，车队提醒他“注意身后的弗兰科”，但从未指示他让对方超车，也没有告诉他身后对他的队友构成任何威胁。
不过，他同时也向车队表达了自己的不满，在关于科拉平托的消息发出后不久，他就说“我不想和你说话，无线电结束”。
尽管由于在马德里赛道赛道超车困难，Colapinto从未发起进攻，但他在进站圈被Gasly阻挡，使得Piastri得以将本圈开始时2.3秒的差距缩小到仅剩十分之二秒。这位迈凯伦车手从未真正接近完成超越，但Colapinto对被队友阻挡感到愤怒是情有可原的。
Gasly证实，赛后车队内部就此事的经过进行了交谈，不过两位车手都没有透露任何关于处理结果的细节。
"我们显然和车队讨论过了，"当被问及车队内部的后续影响时，Gasly说道。"当时并没有要求真正进行位置交换，但这一切都已经和车队讨论过了，一切都已澄清。"
detailEn: Pierre Gasly has hit out at "disturbing" social media abuse and threats received by him and his family members, including his girlfriend, after holding up Alpine Formula 1 team-mate Franco Colapinto in the Spanish Grand Prix.

This arose from a lap late in the Madring race when he held up Colapinto, who was on his way to finishing seventh but being chased by McLaren's Oscar Piastri, on an in-lap before pitting. Although this didn't cost Colapinto a position, it did lead to him being backed up into Piastri and caused him to complain multiple times over the radio.
Gasly, who finished 12th, and those around him were then subject to attacks on a variety of social media platforms that he has described as inappropriate.
"Personally, I find it a little bit disturbing for our sport," said Gasly when asked by The Race about how he dealt with the social media backlash.

"I'm a top athlete, so I know I'm exposed, it's always been the case, but the extent of the threats, attacks, I find completely inappropriate, especially when it reaches out to family members, [my] girlfriend etc. I don't think that should be the case.
"Things were not that way in the past and as a sport we just need to find a way to make it a healthier place because you're exposed, you know you are going to be attacked.

"You can be liked, disliked, it's completely fine, but there is a certain line that should not be crossed just because you're behind a screen and a keyboard, and these lines are crossed too many times."
Colapinto said he's aware of the abuse and backed Gasly's position about the need to stop it happening.

"I think he got a lot of people messaging him," said Colapinto. "I haven't seen it because I'm not on social media a lot, but it's never nice to get it, even more when it's happening to the team that I'm racing in.

"We are team-mates and we get on very well together. We are playing and focusing on the same result, and [have] the same goal and the same target - that is to make Alpine better. We are always working as a team and it's not nice to see it.
"So, hopefully, they can stop it. The same happened to other drivers - Yuki [Tsunoda] last year, it was quite bad as well at one point, I talked about it.

"The stewards, after Zandvoort, I went to see them as well. They had some abuse after the penalty they gave me. It happens a lot with fans in Formula 1, in any sport nowadays, it's something very common.
"Unfortunately, that shouldn't be common. Definitely, we should be taking more care about the things, the words that come out of the keyboards of everyone.
"The way to support us as a team is to push the team forward and stay strong together.

"Hopefully, it doesn't keep happening. But it's something tricky with fans in the sport. It's not just my fans. I've got some very passionate ones. They want me to do well. Hopefully, they can enjoy the good results I'm having."

Colapinto also responded to a suggestion that ultimately what happened between him and Gasly in Madrid wasn't a big deal because of the difficulty of overtaking by pointing out the threat he was under from Piastri.
"Well, I almost got overtaken by Oscar! It was two tenths behind," said Colapinto.

"We spoke in the team and we managed it together. With Pierre, with Flavio [Briatore], Steve [Nielsen], everyone in the team did a very good job in understanding what happened and how to improve it for the next time.
"I'm happy with it, I think. The most important part is to learn from the things that we can improve. The next time, not have the same thing happening - and we move forward."
The situation arose because of the early-race VSC, which had allowed Colapinto, who started on mediums, to pit while Gasly was left out on hards.

Although Gasly complained angrily about this over the radio late in the race, the strategy was justified given it gave Gasly the opportunity to finish as high as sixth in the case of a VSC or safety car, or a red flag, and he never had an opportunity to make a pitstop and emerge from the pits still in the points.

Colapinto spent a substantial period in his second stint stuck behind Gabriel Bortoleto, but had been released when the Audi driver pitted on lap 47. He then began to close on Gasly rapidly, with Piastri chasing him. By the start of lap 55, he was 1.5s behind Gasly.

When Gasly was told he would pit at the end of that lap, he was warned to "watch for Franco behind", but he was never given an instruction to let him past or told that there was any threat to his team-mate behind.
However, he was also expressing his frustration at the team, saying "I don't want to talk to you, radio over" just after the message about Colapinto.

Although Colapinto never launched an attack given the difficulty of overtaking at the Madring, being held up by Gasly's in-lap allowed Piastri to close a gap of 2.3s at the start of the lap to as little as two tenths. The McLaren driver never got close to making a pass, but Colapinto was justifiably angry at being held up by his team-mate.
Gasly confirmed that there were conversations about how this had played out after the race, although neither driver offered any detail about the outcome.

"We obviously discussed it with the team," said Gasly when asked about the fallout inside the team. "There wasn't a call for an actual swap, but it's all been discussed with the team, and it's all clear."

红牛上个月已经宣布，四届世界冠军维斯塔潘签署了一份新合同，至少留在车队至2030年底。
“我们非常兴奋能继续与伊萨克同行。自从今年年初加入我们以来，他在赛道上和赛道外都表现出色，尤其是考虑到这只是他第二个F1赛季，这让续约成为一个容易的决定，”红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯说道。
“从一开始，伊萨克就全身心融入车队，在工厂里与工程师们分秒必争地研发赛车，总是渴望学习和进步。
“从墨尔本的第一场比赛周末就能看出，他以非凡的沉着应对了这次跃升，并赢得了这个席位。”
不是双关……续约了！红牛用一段搞笑视频宣布哈贾尔合同！
维斯塔潘身边的第二个红牛席位被广泛认为是F1发车格上最难的位置，此前包括皮埃尔·加斯利、亚历克斯·阿尔本、利亚姆·劳森和角田裕毅在内的多位车手都在与这位荷兰人的较量中陷入困境。
但哈贾尔比这些车手更接近维斯塔潘，本赛季甚至有时胜过队友，因此他的席位并未受到质疑。
尽管缺席了最近三个比赛周末，哈贾尔仍在车手积分榜上排名第八，并在红牛和迈凯伦成功上诉加斯利被推翻的超速处罚后，重新获得了摩纳哥大奖赛的领奖台席位。
伊萨克·哈贾尔在红牛上诉后重新回到摩纳哥领奖台，阿尔派对皮埃尔·加斯利在维修区超速的处罚被恢复表示不满。
“他受伤以来的这段时间对伊萨克来说很艰难，但这次续约证明了我们对他有多么信任，我们迫不及待想看到他在赛道上回归，”梅基斯继续说道。
“本赛季我们还有很多目标要实现，但知道车手、工程师和工厂里的每个人都在朝着同一个方向前进，专注且团结，这种感觉很棒。”
“哈贾尔因为手臂和手腕受伤缺席了最近三站。据我了解，那是他在训练中打重沙袋造成的，因为他在训练中会打拳击。
“但他已经康复，本周末将参赛，并且他将在2027年成为马克斯·维斯塔潘的搭档。
“哈贾尔将继续留在红牛。利亚姆·劳森在他缺席期间替补表现得非常好，但没有人对哈贾尔获得继续留队的认可感到意外。
“他可能是自丹尼尔·里卡多多年前离开以来，维斯塔潘最具竞争力的队友。”
哈贾尔补充道：“我非常兴奋能继续与Oracle红牛车队合作。我在八个月前来到这支车队，立刻明白了这个组织的规模和雄心。
“工厂里有那么多才华横溢的人，你会意识到能为这样一支不可思议的车队效力，与像马克斯这样的四届世界冠军并肩作战，是一种特权。
“从我签约的那一刻起，我就决心为车队奉献自己，在洛朗和米尔顿凯恩斯所有人的支持下，我得以证明他们对我的信任是值得的。我不断寻求倾听、学习，并每天进一步推动自己，思考未来的一切。”
皮埃尔·加斯利和伊萨克·哈贾尔参观太阳马戏团，尝试了一些搞笑的特技！
“如果你足够优秀，就能留下”——哈贾尔谈续约和伤愈复出
周三晚些时候在巴库出席车手新闻发布会时，哈贾尔对媒体表示，他对合同续约谈判完全放松——甚至声称自己不知道合同期限有多长。
“我甚至没有谈过这件事。你知道，我让我的人替我谈，”他说。
“我在赛道上谈[判]，就这样。所以是的，非常容易。”
当被问及是否是多年合同时，哈贾尔回答说：“我其实不知道。我不在乎。是的，但是，你知道，如果你足够优秀，就能留下，就这样。”
这位法国人还谈到了他手腕伤势的性质以及康复过程。

"We're very excited to continue our journey with Isack. Since joining us at the start of the year, he has been superb on and off track, especially considering this is only his second Formula 1 season, which made extending his contract an easy decision," said Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies.
"From the very beginning, Isack immersed himself in the team, spending every minute at the factory with his engineers to develop the car, always eager to learn and improve.

The second Red Bull seat alongside Verstappen is widely regarded as the toughest on the F1 grid after several drivers including Pierre Gasly, Alex Albon, Liam Lawson and Yuki Tsunoda all struggled against the Dutchman.
But, Hadjar has been closer to Verstappen than those drivers and has even got the better of his team-mate at times this season, so his seat has not come under scrutiny.

Despite missing the last three race weekends, Hadjar is still eighth in the Drivers' Championship and reclaimed his Monaco Grand Prix podium after Red Bull and McLaren successfully appealed Gasly's overturned speeding penalties.

"The period since his injury has been a difficult one for Isack, but this extension is a testament to how much we believe in him and we can't wait to see him back out on track," continued Mekies.

"We still have a lot we want to achieve this season, but it's a great feeling to know that the drivers, engineers and everyone back at the factory are all heading in the same direction, committed and together."
"Hadjar has been out for the last three rounds because he damaged his arm and wrist. I understand that was done by hitting a heavy bag in training because he does boxing in training.
"But he has recovered, he is taking part this weekend, and he will be Max Verstappen's partner in 2027.
"Hadjar will be continuing with Red Bull. Liam Lawson deputised very well in his absence but nobody was surprised that Hadjar gets the nod to carry on.
"He has probably been Verstappen's most competitive teammate since Daniel Ricciardo left a few years ago."
Hadjar added: "I am really excited to continue with Oracle Red Bull Racing. I came to this team eight months ago and immediately understood the scale and ambition of this organisation.
"There are so many talented people at the factory, and you're aware of the privilege of driving for such an incredible team alongside a four-time world champion like Max.

"From the moment I signed, I set out to dedicate myself to the team, and with the support of Laurent and everyone in Milton Keynes, I've been able to justify the faith they've had in me. I'm constantly looking to listen, learn and push myself further every single day about what lies ahead."

Speaking to the media later on Wednesday in Baku when appearing in the Drivers' Press Conference, Hadjar said he had been completely relaxed about the contract renewal discussions - even claiming he did not know how long the deal was for.
"I didn't even talk about it. You know, I let my people do the talking for me," he said.
"I do it [the talking] on the track and that's about it. So yeah, it was very easy."
And asked whether it was a mufti-year term, Hadjar replied: "I actually don't know. I don't care. Yeah, but, you know, if you're good, you stay, and that's it."
The Frenchman also spoke about the nature of his wrist injury and how his rehabilitation had gone.

detailEn: Red Bull has officially retained Isack Hadjar as Max Verstappen's team-mate for the 2027 Formula 1 season.
The team made the announcement upon Hadjar's return from injury at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix in Baku, after he'd missed three rounds with a wrist fracture.

He had been having a very productive first season in the team before that, arguably the closest of Verstappen's team-mates since Daniel Ricciardo, though this may have been aided by the competitive re-balancing triggered by the new-for-2026 cars and power units.
Team boss Laurent Mekies says Hadjar "has been superb on and off track, especially considering this is only his second Formula 1 season, which made extending his contract an easy decision".
"The period since his injury has been a difficult one for Isack, but this extension is a testament to how much we believe in him and we can't wait to see him back out on track," Mekies added.

Hadjar has scored 71 points to Verstappen's 145 (over three more rounds) and has scored a podium in Monaco - which was taken away and then reinstated in a drawn-out appeals process over Pierre Gasly's penalty.
Attention now turns to Red Bull's second team Racing Bulls, where rookie Arvid Lindblad is virtually certain to remain but there's more intrigue surrounding team-mate Liam Lawson.

Red Bull has Formula 2 title contender Nikola Tsolov waiting in the wings for an F1 debut, but Lawson has acquitted himself very well standing in for Hadjar and has had a strong season at Racing Bulls so appears to be the favourite to stay on.

detailZh: 红牛为F1 2027赛季保留伊萨克·哈贾尔，与马克斯·维斯塔潘搭档
伊萨克·哈贾尔赢得了与四届世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘并肩作战的第二个红牛F1赛季
红牛已确认2027赛季F1车手阵容保持不变，伊萨克·哈贾尔将继续与马克斯·维斯塔潘搭档。
哈贾尔在姊妹车队小红牛度过新秀赛季后，于2026年升入红牛，并在这一历史上颇具挑战性的红牛二号席位上展现出速度。
这位法国车手因伤缺席三场比赛后，将于本周末在阿塞拜疆站回归赛场，并将在2027赛季继续与维斯塔潘并肩作战，后者近期已续约至2030年。
“我们非常兴奋能继续与伊萨克同行，”红牛车队负责人洛朗·梅基斯表示。“自今年年初加入我们以来，他在场上和场下都表现出色，尤其是考虑到这只是他第二个F1赛季，这让续约成为轻而易举的决定。”
“从一开始，伊萨克就全身心融入车队，在工厂与工程师们分秒必争地研发赛车，始终渴望学习和进步。从墨尔本的第一场比赛就能看出，他以非凡的沉着应对了这次跃升，并赢得了这个席位。”
尽管缺席了赞德沃特、蒙扎和马德里三站比赛，哈贾尔仍位居积分榜第八，这得益于他在摩纳哥为红牛拿下首个领奖台，加上2025年的首个领奖台，以及在红牛这辆大体上是F1第三或第四快赛车上连续七次进入前六名的表现。
“我非常兴奋能继续与Oracle红牛车队合作，”这位21岁的车手说道。“工厂里有太多才华横溢的人，你清楚能为这样一支不可思议的车队效力，与像马克斯这样的四届世界冠军并肩作战是一种特权。”
“从我签约的那一刻起，我就立志为车队奉献一切，在洛朗和米尔顿凯恩斯所有人的支持下，我得以证明他们对我的信任是正确的。我不断寻求倾听、学习，并每天推动自己更进一步，这只会让我对未来的前景更加兴奋。”
小红牛尚未确认其2027赛季车手阵容，现任车手利亚姆·劳森和阿尔维德·林德布拉德本赛季均有亮眼表现，车队还有青训车手尼古拉·措洛夫待命。
detailEn: Red Bull retains Isack Hadjar alongside Max Verstappen for F1 2027
Isack Hadjar has earned a second Red Bull Formula 1 campaign alongside four-time world champion Max Verstappen
Red Bull has confirmed it will field an unchanged Formula 1 driver line-up in 2027, with Isack Hadjar staying put alongside Max Verstappen.
Hadjar stepped up in 2026 after a rookie season at sister team Racing Bulls, and has impressed with his speed in what has historically been a difficult second Red Bull seat.

The Frenchman, who is making his return in Azerbaijan this weekend after missing three races through injury, will stay on board for another campaign in 2027 alongside Verstappen, who recently signed a contract extension to 2030.

"We’re very excited to continue our journey with Isack," said Red Bull team boss Laurent Mekies. "Since joining us at the start of the year, he has been superb on and off track, especially considering this is only his second Formula 1 season, which made extending his contract an easy decision.

"From the very beginning, Isack immersed himself in the team, spending every minute at the factory with his engineers to develop the car, always eager to learn and improve. You could see from that first weekend in Melbourne that he handled the step up with remarkable composure and had earned his place in this seat."

Despite sitting out Zandvoort, Monza and Madrid, Hadjar still holds eighth in the standings, boosted by a first Red Bull podium in Monaco to complement his maiden podium in 2025, as well as a streak of seven consecutive top-six finishes in what has largely been F1's third or fourth quickest car.

"I am really excited to continue with Oracle Red Bull Racing," the 21-year-old said. "There are so many talented people at the factory, and you’re aware of the privilege of driving for such an incredible team alongside a four-time world champion like Max.

"From the moment I signed, I set out to dedicate myself to the team, and with the support of Laurent and everyone in Milton Keynes, I’ve been able to justify the faith they’ve had in me. I’m constantly looking to listen, learn and push myself further every single day, which only makes me more excited about what lies ahead."

Racing Bulls is yet to confirm its own driver line-up for 2027, with incumbents Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad having both impressed this season while the squad also has junior driver Nikola Tsolov waiting in the wings.

items.summaryEn: Williams is bringing a major upgrade package to the Azerbaijan Grand Prix focused largely on weight reduction with some aerodynamic changes, but the team has fallen far below expectations this season and sits ninth in the standings. Guests on The Race F1 Podcast argued the upgrade will only bring the team back to where it should have been much earlier and is unlikely to change its competitive position.
detailZh: 威廉姆斯长期以来一直宣称其重建计划的主要焦点是为抓住F1 2026年重大规则变化做好准备，但在它曾承诺要向前跃进的这个赛季，它却倒退了。
去年车队获得车队积分榜第五并登上领奖台，如今却仅以11分位列积分榜第九（比2025年同期14轮后少59分），今年平均只是第九快的赛车，单圈速度平均落后2.8%。
本周末它为阿塞拜疆大奖赛带来一套重大升级包，主要聚焦于减重，同时也包含空气动力学改动。
Edd Straw、Ben Anderson和Samarth Kanal在最新一期The 比赛 F1播客中讨论了威廉姆斯在巴库的这个重要周末。
Ben Anderson：我们知道，多携带重量就像白白送掉圈速，对吧？所以他们应该会有所进步，但我不认为这会是彻底改变命运的一步——除非他们减掉了40公斤或50公斤这种离谱的数字。我不认为这会完全改变他们的世界。我倒愿意认为他们或许能回到那个区间，即在某个周末与哈斯中最好的那辆车较量，与那两辆车中试图留在Q2底部的那一辆竞争。
我认为威廉姆斯实际上是第十好的车，拥有梅赛德斯动力单元这件事美化了它，也真正暴露了他们作为一支车队的问题。所以他们迫切需要在底盘方面看到重大进步。
Edd Straw：归根结底，他们为巴库所做的很多事情，我会称之为标准的日常事务，因为你想要达到、甚至低于重量限制。据说这会让它们低于重量限制。这样就能留出一点压舱物，这很有用，可以确保压舱物处于允许的窗口内、放在你想要的位置。
但归根结底，虽然那能带来大量性能，那实际上只是让他们回到本赛季早得多就该处于的位置。所以无论他们今年做什么，他们实际上仍在追赶，只是在消除一些负面因素。
这真的只是一步，不是吗？你只需要看到性能提升。无论如何想象，它都不会突然变成前六名的车，甚至不会变成Q3的车。
Samarth Kanal：他们现在落后太多了，这一切都是在追赶。中游对手车队已经完全在研发上超越了他们，让他们原地踏步。现在威廉姆斯落后太多，我认为这次升级只能让他们处于那个中游集团的底部。
赛车平衡存在如此根本性的问题，整个空气动力学图谱可能都需要重做。那将需要一次极其剧烈的更新——那更多是2027年而非2026年的事。
BA：实际上，自从阿斯顿·马丁把他们B版赛车带到匈牙利、并让威廉姆斯和哈斯都为那里的进步感到惊叹之后，他们就一直在给预期降温。
我认为在阿斯顿·马丁做出那样的举动之前，威廉姆斯对巴库的预期还比较乐观。现在则做了很多预期管理。我认为这是合理的，因为与今年对威廉姆斯的期望相比，他们的表现几乎可以说是令人难堪。
这非常像是2023年到2024年那个循环的重演。而这正是我真正担心威廉姆斯的地方。就像我们以前已经经历过这一幕。
他们在2025年从中走出来得非常好，但2025年的一切都是关于‘我们很早就用风洞测试2026年赛车，我们现在的基准是成为中游集团之首，然后寻求缩小差距’。而他们刚刚远远偏离了那条轨道。

别指望威廉姆斯的升级能让它具备竞争力
ES：车队领队James Vowles在赛季初表示，他们新的基准是去年获得的第五名。所以按照他们自己的标准，他们没有达到，原因各种各样。赛车交付晚了。显然它超重，下压力不足，高斜率概念没有奏效，还有操控麻烦，这种多年来持续存在的三轮行驶问题，他们仍在与之斗争。
ES：要评判他们，我们需要看看他们明年年初会做什么。对我来说那才是关键，因为他们必须消除交付延迟的问题。他们必须达到重量要求。他们必须有正确的空气动力学套件，并且至少在中游集团中表现不错。
因为如果他们做不到，那才是真正该敲响警钟的时候。
detailEn: After declaring for so long that the main focus of its rebuilding programme was being ready to capitalise on Formula 1's major 2026 regulation changes, Williams has tumbled backwards in the season when it had promised to leap forwards.

Fifth in the constructors' championship and a podium finisher last year, now it's ninth in the standings on only 11 points (59 fewer than at this stage, after 14 rounds, in 2025), and has been only the ninth-fastest car on average this year, an average of 2.8% down on single-lap pace.
This weekend it's bringing a major upgrade package to the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, focused largely on weight reduction but also featuring aerodynamic changes.
Edd Straw, Ben Anderson and Samarth Kanal debated Williams's big Baku weekend on the latest episode of The Race F1 Podcast.

Ben Anderson: We know that carrying excess weight is like giving away free laptime, isn't it? So they should make a step but I don't think it will make an absolutely life-changing one - unless they're taking out something like 40kg or 50kg, some nonsensical amount. I don't think it's going to completely change their world. I'd like to think they might get back into that zone of kind of fighting with whichever is the best of the Haases on a given weekend, whichever one of those cars is trying to be at the bottom of Q2.

I think the Williams is actually the 10th-best car and the fact it's got the Mercedes power unit flatters it and really exposes them as a team. So they desperately need to see a big step on the chassis side.

Edd Straw: Ultimately, a lot of what they're doing for Baku is what I'd sort of call the standard housekeeping stuff because you want to be on or in fact under the weight limit. And apparently this will put them under the weight limit. So that'll allow them a little bit of ballast, which is useful to have for making sure you've got the ballast within the allowed window where you want it to be.

But ultimately, while that's a load of performance, that's really only getting them back to where they should have been much earlier in the season. So whatever they do this year, they're still really playing catch-up and just eliminating some of the negatives.
It's just one step really, isn't it? You just need to see the performance improvement. It's not going to suddenly turn into a top-six car by any stretch of the imagination or even a Q3 car.

Samarth Kanal: They are so far behind now that this is all catching up. Rival midfield teams have completely outdeveloped them, left them standing still. and now Williams is so far behind that I think this upgrade can only put them at the bottom of that midfield set.
There's such a fundamental issue in car balance, the whole aero map needs to probably be redone. That's going to need an incredibly drastic update - that's more for 2027 than 2026.
BA: They've been talking it down actually since Aston Martin bought their B-spec car to Hungary and kind of wowed certainly Williams and Haas with the step they took there.

I think before Aston Martin did what they did, Williams were a bit more bullish about what they were expecting from Baku. Now there's been a lot of expectation management. I think that's a reasonable thing to do because compared to expectations of Williams this year, they've been pretty much embarrassing.
This is very much the 2023 into 2024 cycle repeating. And that's the thing I really worry about with Williams. It's like we've been here before.

They came out of it really well in 2025, but then 2025 was all about 'we're in the windtunnel with the 2026 car really early, our baseline now is to be top of the midfield and then look to bridge the gap'. And they've just fallen way off that track.
'Everything was on fire' - Williams's F1 2026 disaster laid bare
Don't expect Williams's upgrade to make it competitive

ES: James Vowles, the team principal, said at the start of the season that their new baseline is the fifth place they got last year. So they've fallen short by their own standards and there's all sorts of reasons for that. The car was late. Obviously it's overweight, downforce isn't there and the high rake concept didn't work, there are handling troubles, this sort of three-wheeling problem that's been persistent over a number of years that they're still battling.

ES: To judge them, we need to see what they do at the start of next year. That for me is the critical thing because they've got to eliminate the problems with being late. They've got to be on the weight. They've got to have the right aero package and be performing decently in that midfield at the very least.
Because if they're not there, then that's when you really start to sound the alarm bells.

items.summaryEn: Formula 1 heads to the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the first race of a punishing triple-header that could prove defining for the world championship, with six technical storylines worth watching.
detailZh: 一级方程式即将来到阿塞拜疆大奖赛，这是艰苦三连赛的第一站，而这三场比赛可能会对世界冠军的归属起到决定性作用。
但这并不是车队推出重大升级的理想之地，通常在这样一连串背靠背比赛中他们都会这么做。
巴库赛道的布局拥有长长的直道，这使得空气动力学效率比下压力更为重要，因此重点更多放在优化而不是改进上。
这就是为什么梅赛德斯和法拉利等车队预计会再等一等，才去冲刺他们很可能是一年中最后一套的研发升级包。
但本周末仍有许多值得关注的技战术看点。
在F1新规则时代开局不顺之后，威廉姆斯车队希望阿塞拜疆大奖赛能成为其复苏的起点。
此前一直按兵不动、未对赛车进行大改，如今所有人的目光都集中在其全新的更轻底盘上，车队希望这能成为摆脱车手们迄今被迫背负的多余重量的关键一步。
这次威廉姆斯升级特别引人关注之处在于，车队领队詹姆斯·沃利斯谈到新底盘在制造方式上蕴含创新。
“这次学到的经验将为我们未来五年打下基础，”他最近告诉The 比赛。
“围场里没有任何其他底盘是像我们这样造出来的。我可以向你保证这一点。”
威廉姆斯究竟做了什么还没有被详细解释，但据了解，这围绕一些制造工艺展开，这些工艺让车队减掉了超出正常预期的更多重量。
但需要提醒一句。沃勒斯和车手们都没有期待性能会出现改变格局的飞跃。
正如亚历克斯·阿尔本所说："这会是一个不错的进步，但是否会是全面的进步呢？我对此抱有希望，但我不认为会是。"
阿斯顿·马丁几乎把所有空气动力学升级都留到了匈牙利大奖赛期间的中季底盘大改款上，车队领队兼技术管理合伙人阿德里安·纽维削减了重量，并解决了他最初的 AMR26 概念车的种种弱点。
由于车队希望确保以良好状态开启2027赛季，它不想把研发延续到本赛季末，这就是它放缓升级频率的原因。
但这并不意味着它不会带来新部件——在巴库，它预计将引入一些更轻量化的部件，以便更接近768公斤的重量限制。
车队的赛道事务主管迈克·克拉克在西班牙大奖赛上表示，这些改动很可能不会引起注意，因为车队只需向国际汽联正式申报那些外观不同的部件。
“我们接下来还会带来一些新部件，有些必须申报，有些则不用，”他说，“我不认为（阿斯顿·马丁的研发）已经彻底完成，但我认为我们不会再有像布达佩斯那样的升级了。”
虽然厂队法拉利以及它的客户车队之一哈斯从9月初的蒙扎意大利大奖赛起就已经使用了马拉内罗最新的ADUO 2规格引擎，但凯迪拉克到目前为止一直没有动手。
由于安装经过修改的动力单元存在复杂性，需要更换新的部件，凯迪拉克希望在蒙扎和马德里赛道的连续双站比赛结束后，再决定是否启用它。
车队目前已放行，允许塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯在巴库使用它，而瓦尔特里·博塔斯则还得再等一段时间。
发动机升级带来的额外动力对凯迪拉克来说将是一次广受欢迎的提升，车队同时还会引入一些小幅空气动力学升级。
ADUO 2（第二阶段升级单元）很可能也将成为法拉利关注的话题，因为厂商正在权衡本赛季余下比赛的动力单元计划。
夏尔·勒克莱尔在意大利大奖赛发生撞车时正在使用的ADUO 2发动机，很可能将在阿塞拜疆重返赛道进行评估，但他也有可能拿到一台全新的发动机，以支撑他跑完本赛季的剩余征程。
巴库的长直道意味着这里是接受更换引擎而退后发车位置的好地方。
迈凯伦的H翼连同另一项升级一同回归。
迈凯伦自夏休期以来从其MCL40上挖掘出了丰富的性能提升空间，在快速和中速弯角上取得了重大进步。
不过车队仍然清楚一些核心弱点，尤其是在直线性能和低速弯道方面。
对于拥有那条非常长的发车/终点大直道的巴库站，迈凯伦将重新启用其低阻力的“H翼”尾翼，该部件在意大利大奖赛上首次投入使用。
车队还计划评估另一套升级套件，希望能在此前相比主要对手损失圈速的领域带来提升。
技术总监罗布·马歇尔表示，规则保持稳定意味着没有理由停止继续推出升级。
“由于规则将延续到下个赛季，且前方竞争如此接近，我们持续研发赛车的动力依然很高，”他说。
巴库的赛道布局对当前能源匮乏的赛车来说是有利有弊。
由1号弯到16号弯组成的低速急弯和城市赛段，应当能提供大量为电池充电并释放额外电能的机会。
但从16号弯一直延伸到第一个弯角的极长直道，将是电池效率和电量状态至关重要的地方。
各车队需要评估的一点是，2026年赛车下压力的降低是否意味着18/19号弯的高速组合弯仍然可以全油门通过。
如果可以的话，那将意味着一种与需要升挡不同的能量部署模式，这会为能量回收带来一定的提升。
另一个可能在整个周末带来麻烦的问题是，在练习赛和排位赛中，暖胎圈慢速行驶的赛车与做出冲刺圈快圈赛车之间可能出现的巨大速度差。
各车队会希望对他们的电机发电一体机进行编程，在排位赛中尽可能晚地、直到计时线之前才消耗电池电量，这意味着在此之前沿主直道行驶时内燃机的输出会较慢。
这意味着这些赛车的速度曲线将与那些从16号弯驶出时就已最大化利用能量的赛车截然不同，因此后者将以快得多的速度接近起点/终点线。
detailEn: Formula 1 heads to the Azerbaijan Grand Prix for the first race of a punishing triple-header that could prove defining for the world championship.
But it is not an ideal place for teams to unleash the kind of major upgrades they typically would for such a run of back-to-backs.
The layout of the Baku circuit with its long straights puts a premium on aero efficiency over downforce, so the focus is more on optimisation rather than improvement.
That is why teams such as Mercedes and Ferrari are expected to wait a little bit longer before gunning for what will likely be their final development packages of the year.
But there remains plenty of tech intrigue to keep an eye out for this weekend.
After a troubled start to F1's new rules era, Williams hopes that the Azerbaijan GP will mark the start of its recovery.

Having held fire on a major car revamp until now, all eyes will be on the new, lighter chassis that it hopes will mark a step-change in getting rid of the excess weight its drivers have been forced to carry around so far.

What will make the Williams upgrade especially interesting is that team principal James Vowles has talked of there being innovation at the heart of the new chassis when it comes to how it has been manufactured.
"This learning will be one that kicks us off for the next five years," he told The Race recently.
"There's no other chassis in the grid made the way we've done it. I can give you an assurance of that."

Exactly what Williams has done has not been explained in detail yet, but it is understood to revolve around some manufacturing processes that have allowed the team to shed off more mass than would normally be expected.
But a word of caution. Neither Vowles nor the drivers are anticipating a game-changing leap in performance.
As Alex Albon said: "It's going to be a good step, but is it going to be the full step? I'm hopeful for it, but I don't think it would be."

Aston Martin saved pretty much all its aero upgrades for its mid-season chassis overhaul at the Hungarian GP, as team principal and managing technical partner Adrian Newey slashed weight and addressed the weaknesses of his first AMR26 concept.
With the team wanting to make sure it starts 2027 on the front foot, it does not want to continue development into the end of this season, which is why it has wound down its update rate.
But that does not mean it will not bring new parts - and in Baku it is set to introduce some lighter components to get down closer to the 768kg weight limit.
Chief trackside officer Mike Krack said at the Spanish GP that the changes will likely go under the radar, as teams only have to officially declare to the FIA components that look different.

"We still bring some more parts going forward, some will be declared because we have to, some will not," he said. "I don't think it [Aston Martin's development] is completely finished, but I don't think that we will have an upgrade like Budapest."
While the works Ferrari team and one of its customers, Haas, have both used Maranello's latest ADUO 2-spec engine since the Italian GP at Monza in early September, Cadillac has held fire so far.
Due to complications of installing the revised power unit, which requires new parts, Cadillac wanted to wait until after the Monza/Madrid double-header before committing to it.
It has now given the green light for Sergio Perez to run it in Baku, while Valtteri Bottas will have to wait a little bit longer.
The extra power on offer from the engine upgrade will be a welcome boost to Cadillac, which will also be introducing some small aerodynamic upgrades as well.
ADUO 2 will likely be a topic of interest at Ferrari as well, as the manufacturer weighs up its power unit plans over the remainder of the season.

Charles Leclerc's ADUO 2 engine, which was in use when he crashed in the Italian GP, is likely to return to the track for evaluation in Azerbaijan, but it is also possible that he may get a totally fresh one as well to see him through to the end of the campaign.
Baku's long straights mean that it is a good place to take a grid drop for an engine swap.
McLaren's H-wing returns alongside another update
McLaren has unlocked a rich seam of performance from its MCL40 since the summer break, having made big gains in fast- and medium-speed corners.
The team is still mindful of some core weaknesses, though, especially when it comes to straightline performance and low-speed turns.
For Baku, which features that very long start/finish straight, McLaren will bring back into action its low-drag 'H-wing' that it raced for the first time at the Italian GP.
It is also set to evaluate another upgrade package that it hopes can deliver gains in areas where it is giving away laptime to its main rivals.
Chief technical officer Rob Marshall said that rules stability meant there was little reason not to keep the upgrades coming.
"With regulatory continuity into next season and the competition at the front so close, our motivation to keep developing the car remains high," he said.
The Baku layout is a mixed blessing for the current energy-starved cars.
The tight, low-speed corners and city section that make up the sequence from Turn 1 through to Turn 16 should offer plenty of opportunity to charge the battery and unleash added electrical power.
But the extremely long run from Turn 16 all the way through to the first corner is one where battery efficiency and state of charge are going to be critical.
One thing that teams will need to evaluate is whether the reduced downforce of the 2026 cars means that the fast Turn 18/19 sequence can still be taken flat.
If it can, then that will mean a different deployment pattern compared to if it requires a lift, which will deliver a bit of a boost for energy harvesting.
One other issue, which could cause some trouble over the weekend, is of potential big speed differentials between cars on outlaps and cars on push laps in practice and qualifying.

Teams will want to programme their MGU-Ks to not burn up any battery until as late as possible before the timing line in qualifying, which will mean running slower on the internal combustion engine beforehand down the main straight.
That means a speed profile very different from cars that will have maximised energy usage coming out of Turn 16, and that will be approaching the start/finish line much quicker as a result.
